# Integer shifts in allocation arguments

Owned Java 8 factories retain signed int left, arithmetic right and logical
right shifts after the original allocation. Register and literal distances
include negative and masked values. Optional field profiles retain field reads
after target class initialization. A frozen observer computes expected bits by
repeated multiplication/division over an unsigned long representation, without
using the tested Java shift expressions. Source and SDK routes compile every
emitted Java unit and compare original metadata and exact failure identities.
